question: How Is Generative AI Used in Industrial Automation?
body_html:
Generative AI in industrial automation uses large language models to create text and code from a prompt. Its five main plant uses are PLC code drafting in structured text, documentation, troubleshooting assistance, alarm explanation and test case creation.

Generated logic must be compiled, simulated, verified and approved by an engineer, because models can hallucinate tags or instructions. Main risks are weak verification, IP leakage, cybersecurity and over trust, so human in the loop review is mandatory.
